name: Break-even
description: Find out how many units you must sell each month to cover your costs, with a chart and a profit simulator.
prompt: A break-even calculator for small businesses with fixed costs, selling price and cost per unit, the units needed to break even, a chart of revenue and costs, and a slider to see profit or loss for any sales volume.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Descubre cuántas unidades debes vender cada mes para cubrir tus costes, con un gráfico y un simulador de beneficios.
